meta.matrix: 16 floats, row major, ROW VECTORS: world = local * parent ; translation is elements 12,13,14
meta.euler: degrees. rotate order 'xyz' means R = Rx * Ry * Rz with row vectors (rotate about X first)
meta.joint_local: joint local matrix = S * R(rotate, rotateOrder) * R(jointOrient, xyz) * T(translate)
meta.values: control values are offsets from rest; every animatable channel of these controls rests at 0

ik_switches.tool: fkik.set_follow (keeps the goal position, the pv position and the end control orientation)
none: a plain value (the clavicle moves when it changes)
fkik.follow_all (COG right-click): set_follow on both legs / arms at once

how: Two extra chains next to the drv chain: bnsik_* (solved by the IK handle, goal = *_trans, pole = *_pv) and bnsfk_* (each joint = the world orientation of its FK control, orientConstraint mo=False).

drv upper / mid joints: orientConstraint(ik, fk), interp shortest; weight of ik = IKFK, of fk = 1 - IKFK (node bns_<s>_<limb>_ikfk_rev). The drv end joint (hand / foot) is oriented by the end control as before.

FK controls: <s>_UpperArm_fk / _LowerArm_fk, <s>_Thigh_fk / _Calf_fk. The first sits under bns_<s>_<limb>_fk_root (parentConstraint, mo, to the parent of the chain: clavicle / pelvis), the second is its child. The mid FK control turns about one axis only (fk_mid_hinge_axis), the other axes are locked.
IKFK is a float 0..1: in-between values blend the two chains (shortest slerp per joint). The tools key it with step tangents at 0 or 1; the in-between cases are there to check the blend math.

Switching with the pose kept (match / snap) is done by the tools (bns_rig.fkik.switch), not by the rig: the rig itself has no snapping. FK -> IK puts Hand_trans / pv where the FK hand / elbow are; IK -> FK turns the FK controls to the IK chain.

follow (enum): weights of the parentConstraint on the goal's ik_cns = (follow == i) per target (condition nodes bns_<s>_<limb>_follow<i>). Targets: arm bns_world_follow / chest drv_spine_05 / drv_pelvis (/ drv_hand_r for L), leg bns_world_follow / drv_pelvis.

End control (Hand_rot / Foot_rot) ik_cns orientation: orientConstraint over end_space<i> helpers (children of the follow targets, rest orientation of ik_cns) + end_fk (child of the mid drv joint). weight(space i) = (follow == i) * fixed, weight(end_fk) = 1 - fixed, fixed = (wrist/ankleFollow == 1) * IKFK. Arm: its position follows the mid drv joint (parentConstraint, rotate skipped).

pvFollow (enum): pole vector ik_cns parentConstraint, weights: Body target(s) = (pvFollow == 0) [leg: x (follow == i)], last target = (pvFollow == 1). Arm Hand: the goal Hand_trans. Leg Foot: bns_<s>_kneepv_aim, a frame at the hip aiming at Foot_trans with the pelvis side axis as up (aimConstraint).

autoShoulder (keyable 0..1, arm): Shoulder_rot_bnsdrv.rotate = pairBlend(0, bns_<s>_autoShoulder_aim.rotate, weight = autoShoulder * IKFK * 0.5), quaternion slerp. The aim node aims at Hand_trans (aimConstraint, mo).
Display only: bns_<s>_<limb>_ikvis / _fkvis hide the controls of the inactive mode; bns_<s>_<limb>_ui_* feed the picker.
